newsitem.title: USA: Liposome Co to redeem depository shares.
newsitem.headline: Liposome Co to redeem depository shares.

text.p: Liposome Co Inc said Friday it had made a call to redeem all outstanding shares of its Series A 7.75 percent Cumulative Convertible Exchangeable Preferred Stock represented by depositary shares.
The redemption date will be October 14, it said.

"By making this call for redemption, The Liposome Company will avoid approximately $2.3 million each year in dividend payments, which instead can be directed to help fund the company's product development programs," it said.
Each depositary share represents 1/10 of a share of Preferred Stock, it said.

The total cash receivable on redemption of a depositary share is $26.9597, which includes the current redemption price of $26.40 and the accrued dividend for the third and part of the fourth quarters of $0.5597, it added.

Liposome is a biotechnology company that develops lipid- and liposome-based pharmaceuticals for the treatment, prevention and diagnosis of inadequately treated, life-threatening diseases like metastatic breast cancer.
